exec: pm.test("Response contains the created sector", function () { pm.expect(sector.sectorName).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("sectorName")); });
pm.test("Sector list is returned", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("Created sector is in the list", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(function (sector) { return sector.id === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("sectorId")); })).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Sector is fetched by ID", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("sectorId"))); });

pm.test("Response contains the created stock", function () { pm.expect(stock.ticker).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("stockTicker")); pm.expect(stock.sectorId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("sectorId"))); });
pm.test("Empty ticker list is rejected", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); });

item.name: Filter Stocks by Sector and Ticker

exec: pm.test("Filtered stock is returned", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("array").with.lengthOf(1); pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].ticker).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("stockTicker")); });
pm.test("Stock is fetched by ID", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("stockId"))); });

pm.test("Bulk request creates stocks", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(pm.response.json().created).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(pm.response.json().skipped).to.be.an("array"); });
pm.test("First bulk stock is deleted", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test("Second bulk stock is deleted", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
pm.test("Sector is deleted after its stocks", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });

item.name: India NSE Symbols
item.description: All NSE stock and ETF ticker symbols and names for dropdowns. Synced weekly (Sunday 06:00 IST) from NSE's free official CSV files; no API key.

item.name: Sync NSE Stock and ETF Lists

request.description: Download NSE's EQUITY_L.csv and eq_etfseclist.csv now (the scheduler does this weekly). Returns equity/ETF counts. 502 if NSE fails; previous lists are kept.
Type-ahead search by ticker or name; best matches first. Reads the stored NSE CSV files.
type=ETF returns only ETFs from eq_etfseclist.csv.
No query returns every NSE equity, ordered by ticker.
type must be EQUITY or ETF.

item.name: US Symbols (Nasdaq Trader)
item.description: All US-listed stock and ETF ticker symbols and names for dropdowns (NASDAQ, NYSE, NYSE American, NYSE Arca, Cboe, IEX). Synced daily (06:00 America/New_York) from Nasdaq Trader's free symbol directory; no API key.

item.name: Sync US Stock and ETF Lists

request.description: Download nasdaqlisted.txt and otherlisted.txt now (the scheduler does this daily). Returns equity/ETF counts. 502 if Nasdaq Trader fails; previous lists are kept.
Type-ahead search by ticker or name; best matches first. Reads the stored Nasdaq Trader files.
type=ETF returns only rows whose ETF column is Y.
No query returns every symbol of the type, ordered by ticker.
type must be EQUITY or ETF; anything else is 400.
